facts: GLA defines a Site Allocation as a site allocated for a particular development or use within a development plan
GLA states allocated sites provide guidelines for planning decisions and promote development at borough level
The GLA Site Allocations dataset publishes three files/resources
The GLA Site Allocations GeoPackage is approximately 5.11 MB
The GLA Site Allocations GeoPackage uses EPSG:27700 British National Grid
The GLA Site Allocations dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v3
GLA explicitly describes the GIS boundaries as indicative
GLA explicitly directs users to the relevant London Borough to confirm boundary accuracy
